sources.title: Annual ballet program page, manual browser observation
Annual ballet checkout, USD selected, no purchase

name.value: Victory Skating / VSA 1-Year Online Ballet Club

description.value: An ongoing online group ballet program with a one-year enrollment option and 48 live Saturday classes with Coach Emilia.

audience.notes: Open to all experience levels; not restricted to figure skaters.

requirements.notes: Equipment observed on the annual program page. No additional age or medical requirements inferred.

price.notes: USD selected in the checkout on 2026-10-06. This is an observation, not business-approved pricing or a live price guarantee.

billing.notes: The checkout described annual recurring billing until cancellation. Not a one-time purchase.

commercialConsistency.notes: The per-class marketing has not been reconciled with the annual checkout total. The crossed-out $499 is not a current payable price.

additionalCharges.notes: Taxes and mandatory additional charges have not been established.

cancellationPolicy.value: Cancellation at least 48 hours before the next payment through subscriptions in email.
cancellationPolicy.notes: Manual checkout observation only. Recheck the provider's current terms before paying.

refundPolicy.notes: Manual checkout observation only; no broader refund rules inferred.

advertisedTimes.notes: Published labels only. They do not establish a canonical IANA time zone or year-round DST behavior.

localStartTime.notes: No canonical local start time has been confirmed.

timeZone.notes: No canonical IANA time zone has been confirmed. Do not infer it from contact details or advertised offsets.

dstPolicy.notes: The region whose daylight-saving changes govern the schedule is unknown.

exceptions.notes: No confirmed calendar of breaks or exceptions is available. 48 classes does not guarantee 52 Saturday sessions.

enrollment.notes: Ongoing program status and a working checkout page do not establish current enrollment availability.

accessStartRule.notes: The trigger for starting each participant's one-year entitlement is unknown.

accessEndRule.notes: The expiry rule is unknown. Do not assume 365 days, 48 consecutive Saturdays, or a start on payment.

checkoutUrl.notes: Official linked destination loaded for the annual ballet product. No transaction was submitted; enrollment and access rules remain unknown.

checkoutTitle.notes: Title displayed in the checkout during the recorded observation.

observations.text: The landing page displayed $499 with a line-through decoration. Do not treat it as a current payable annual price; the symbol alone does not establish an ISO currency.
The landing page displayed $3/class. Do not multiply it by 48 to invent an annual total.
Monthly and private offers are separate products. Their terms must not be imported into the annual group program.
The annual checkout observation and per-class marketing have not been reconciled. Retain both sources and disclose the uncertainty.
